description:
Add a non-required CI job that builds both renderers from the same develop SHA and docs/ sources and runs `site_inventory diff` (astro-site-01) on them.

It checks:
- missing paths
- lost anchors and fragments
- changed titles and headings
- broken internal links
- missing images
- tag pages, archives and series
- atom.xml entry ids
- generated query pages
- the API URL map

It also runs axe over every page template, the docs/blog Explorer-byte check, check_artifact_privacy.py, and the Pagefind smoke search.

Output a URL compatibility report. It requires zero broken public URLs and zero broken fragments. It lists every redirect page and every allowed difference, each with a reason and an owner approval.

Gate G2: the owner reviews and signs off the report before astro-site-53 may start.
